text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chairs a cabinet meeting on trade exchanges with Maghreb countries; recommends to intensify them as part of efforts to build the Maghreb's union.
- President Ben Ali confers with Agriculture Minister Mohamed Ben Rejeb. Recommends to limit imports of meats.
- After a telephone talk last Sunday between President Ben Ali and French President jacques Chirac, Ben Ali's visit date set for January 1997.
- President Ben Ali sends message to the Harare's Solar Energy Summit.
